title: Add explicit credential-gated live smoke runner
description: Create a separate live smoke CLI/docs for shipped providers. Require PI_SEARCH_LIVE=1, explicit provider selection, metered acknowledgement, finite timeout, no retry/fanout, safe credential resolution, redacted output, and assertions for inspectable URLs and supported hard filters. Keep bun test offline.

logs.msg: Implemented scripts/live-smoke.ts and docs/live-smoke.md. Requires PI_SEARCH_LIVE=1, PI_SEARCH_LIVE_ALLOW_METERED=1, and exactly one explicitly selected provider; provider-specific smoke credentials/models are separate, no retries/fallback/fanout, output is redacted/bounded, and default bun test remains offline. Dry-run and fail-closed credential checks verified; source and script TypeScript checks pass.
